fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272084/rates (2026-05-01 to 2026-10-17 and 2027-05-01 to 2027-10-17: 'CONCRETE SITE: 50 AMP & WATER' 28, 'CONCRETE SITE: 50 Amp, Water, & Sewer' 30, 'WALK TO: Non-Electric' 14), read 2026-11-02

values.note: 20 RV sites (T01-T20) plus 2 walk-to tent sites (T21, T22). Lengths 40-69 ft; T13 and T16 pull through; concrete. Sewer at T03, T05, T07, T13, T16, T18, T19, T20.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272084 ('22 campsites to include full hook-up campsites, standard electric campsites, and non-electric walk-to tent campsites') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; RV listed on all 20), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Dump station and drinking water are just outside the West Overlook Campground, whose fee booth is where you register. Fish cleaning station on site.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272084 ('modern restroom with shower facility, and fish cleaning station'; 'the dump station and drinking water is located just outside of the West Overlook Campground'; amenities Flush Toilets, Showers), read 2026-11-02

values.note: 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Register at the West Overlook fee booth before setting up. Check-in 2pm, check-out noon.

note: USACE Coralville Lake, on the west bank of the Iowa River below the dam, concrete pads in an open loop with the river across the park road. --Claude
summary: Changed fees 28/28 -> 28/30 (sewer sites, 2026 and 2027), max_rig 62 -> 69 (catalog), count 22 -> 20 RV + 2 walk-to tent. Confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer, showers, rec.gov. Added flush toilets, water, dump (outside the loop), pull-through, 14-night limit. Rec.gov's rate season isn't a campground season, so season left unset; military flag not written. Pin ~95 m from the loop centre.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (down): stored 'riverfront' fails the rule that a campground's own road between site and water blocks on-water. Imagery at 41.7220,-91.5293 shows the park road running the whole length of the loop's river side, with cars on it (a wide paved or gravel strip along the rip-rap bank); pads are ~30 m+ from the water behind it. The river here is ~70-120 m wide, so a river not a creek. Land between isn't open: I read this as `riverview`, not riverfront. No per-site water tag on rec.gov (catalog has none); rec.gov calls it 'west bank of the Iowa River'. A lagoon pond (~1.3 ha, ~3 acres) lies on the west side of the loop: under 5 acres, pond, no value.
Missing phone: rec.gov gives 'MAY 1 - OCTOBER 31 CAMPGROUND ENTRANCE STATION: (319) 338-3685; NOVEMBER 1 - APRIL 30 CORALVILLE LAKE PROJECT OFFICE (319) 338-3543 x6300'.
Website field has two lines, rec.gov + the MVR Coralville page; the district page wasn't tried.
